job.job_description:
Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain software solutions using AI/GenAI based technologies.
Participate in the entire AI development lifecycle, including data collection, preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and deployment.
Assist in researching and experimenting with state-of-the-art generative AI techniques to improve model performance and capabilities.
Review code developed by other developers, providing feedback adhering to industry standard best practices like coding guidelines.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
Develop and maintain high-quality, scalable, and efficient software applications.
Job Requirements
At least 3 years of experience in software development, with expertise in AI/ML, GenAI, and MLOps concepts.
Strong proficiency in Python, FastAPI, PyTest, Celery, and other Python frameworks.
Experience with object-oriented programming, concurrency, design patterns, and REST APIs.
Familiarity with CI/CD tooling such as Terraform and GitHub Actions.
Understanding of working in a DevOps Model and ability to take ownership of requirements to design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain software.
Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent.
About Company
At Conga, we achieve together - when you have questions, you find answers; when you're faced with challenges, you find solutions. We are a community where colleagues can thrive, with opportunities for innovation and growth through individual and team development.
